title: [3.4] Bolus Progress notification on Wear does not show total amount of insulin to be delivered
symptom: Due to Bolus Progress refactoring in 3.4, the string showing delivered and total amount was replaced with one only showing delivered amount, so on watch the total amount to be delivered is not shown.
cause: The Bolus Progress refactoring removed the total amount from the status string, and the string is now the same for all drivers except Dash which uses a workaround.
fix: A fix is proposed in PR #4480, which likely implements the dedicated wearStatus approach discussed, but the thread does not state the exact final fix.
evidence_quote: I think we should first remove the workaround of Dash driver and use the calculation percent -> amount included in EventOverviewBolusProgress
